runtime overhead
lines_bottom_to_top.source: CUDA runtime of the PyTorch process outside its allocator: non_torch_bytes = 472 MiB in every completed 27B QLoRA probe (results/probes_tidy.csv), default install and fast kernels alike (one first-run compile held 2,088)

whole_card_right.allocator_note: run 3's 21.54 GiB is PyTorch's reserved peak, which includes the caching allocator's slack (0.6 to 1.1 GiB above allocated in the 2,048-token probes), so the computed lines are a slight overestimate of what run 3 allocated (smaller adapter than the probes, loss on reply tokens only)

not_drawn: whatever the desktop holds on the same card (0.9 to 1.8 GiB in the probes); the outline's arrival: 0.5 to 1.5 GiB to spare depending on the desktop
